candidate_transformation: sum of ten decile means divided by ten, conditional on equivalent equal-person deciles
municipality_reconstruction: weight district means by their exact income-eligible 2024 person counts; include any unassigned geography if the municipal denominator includes it
forbidden_weights: 2026 population totals, Airbnb listing counts, equal district weights
rounding_envelope_basis: Two weighted averages of means individually rounded to the nearest whole DKK differ by at most 1 DKK from rounding alone. This is conditional on verified rounding and exact denominator weights; it is not an equivalence acceptance threshold.
acceptance_requires: matching income concept and equivalisation scale
matching income-distribution population and geographic allocation
equal-person deciles or authoritative decile weights
matching nominal price basis, year and unit
